messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Current top‑ranked tennis players (as of October 2026)**  

| Ranking | Player | Nationality | Notes |
|---------|--------|-------------|-------|
| **ATP (Men’s Singles)** | **Novak Djokovic** | Serbia | Holds the No. 1 spot on the ATP rankings, having reclaimed the top position after a brief dip earlier in the year. |
| **WTA (Women’s Singles)** | **Iga Świątek** | Poland | Maintains the No. 1 spot on the WTA rankings, continuing her dominant run since 2022. |

> **How rankings work**  
> • ATP and WTA rankings are updated every Monday, reflecting the points earned over the previous 52 weeks.  
> • The rankings are publicly available on the official ATP (https://www.atptour.com) and WTA (https://www.wtatennis.com) websites, where you can see the full list, points totals, and recent changes.

If you’re looking for the *overall* top player regardless of gender, the ATP No. 1 (Novak Djokovic) is typically considered the world’s best male player, while the WTA No. 1 (Iga Świątek) is the best female player.
